interface.task.灾变防线.description:
This module was contributed by a community member. Currently only supports foreground desktop + Simplified Chinese server. Will try to expand support when free.

Automatically completes the current Cataclysm difficulty challenge in Cataclysm Defense, claims rewards and returns to homepage.

Only supports CN Server Windows desktop 1280×720. Please select 「Desktop (Foreground)」 controller and keep the game window in the foreground the whole time. Real keyboard input will be occupied and mouse may be temporarily taken over. Android, emulators, PlayCover and other resolutions are not supported.

Existing records in both areas will be reused; empty slots will auto-select from the record cards currently on screen (no scrolling). Prepare usable records in advance. Can only challenge once per period — make sure your team can clear it.

After entering the event combat stage, selects “Challenge”, randomly picks a recognizable 2-x stage, then clicks “Depart” and “Deploy”. Repeats the specified number of times after battle ends.
interface.task.猎影合围.label: Shadow Hunt Encirclement
interface.task.猎影合围.description:
1. Consumes resources in order: Assist Hunt → Track Target until the keep amounts are reached
2. Track Target does not use Hunt Permits. If waiting for completion is enabled but no one assists, it will keep waiting until the target escapes
3. In combat, if no record is selected it defaults to the first one. To use a custom record, select it manually and clear once first
4. Uses auto-battle. Make sure you have enough strength. If result is less than 1 star the task will loop infinitely
interface.task.登录游戏.label: Login to Game

interface.task.真格挑战.label: Proving Grounds
interface.task.真格挑战.description:
Automatically completes Proving Grounds. If a default record is available, it is used to enter battle directly. Otherwise, team records are filtered using the selected filter mode, and the first available record is selected.

Notes:

1. If no default record is available, make sure there is an available record matching the filter criteria; otherwise, the task will fail.

2. The challenge runs for up to 10 attempts. Too many failures may prevent all attempts from being used, so use this feature only when your team is strong enough.
